caption: Torque and speed give brake power; fuel flow and calorific value give fuel power; brake thermal efficiency is the ratio of the two. Every other number in this chapter is a rearrangement of this chain.

spec.title: How three measurements give every performance number
spec.aria: Block diagram: measured torque and speed give brake power, measured fuel flow and calorific value give fuel power, and brake thermal efficiency is the ratio of the two.
